'''2022 PC20 Tournament''' was the Players Committee 20th-anniversary constructed event on GEMP, 30 April 2022. [[Tom Strother]] defeated [[Mike Kessling]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-04-pc20-tournament/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' 30 April 2022
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80756 forum]
